metadata.description: V2 create device sensor (POST /devicesensors). Live-captured; response body's uuid was independently re-verified as reliable via a separate raw (non-anonymized) create+list scratch check -- an earlier working assumption that the create response's uuid did not match the real resource was WRONG and has been retracted: it compared this fixture's own anonymized uuid value (anonymize.go unconditionally fakes any '*uuid'-suffixed key) against a real value, which will never match by construction. The real create response uuid does correctly identify the created resource.
